purpose: Reconstruction and audit of the researcher-created seminar analysis. This does not claim to reproduce the original software environment.
important_limitations: The original TF IDF trial is evidenced by its figure and contemporaneous narrative, but its code, assignments, parameters, and corrected mapping were not retained.
The original package versions were not recorded.
The record-level corpus assembly code and screening log were not retained.
The audited topic mapping requires independent human validation before it can be described as validated.
